dict.string: Pets level up (kills, pickups, farm crops at the feeding bowl) and learn utility skills: clear vines, smash pots, stun enemies, mend their owner, fetch from further away, boost morale. Per-pet pickup toggles, pet dyes at the tailor, pets wait outside puzzle rooms, and every Heroes of Hammerwatch 1 pet skin in the Pet Shop (run tools/import_hoh1.py pets). Part of HammerwatchPlus.
